lines.say: A linear equation has x to the power 1 only. No x squared.
The solution is the value of x that makes both sides equal.
Each operation has an inverse that undoes it.
Whatever you do to one side, do it to the other side too.
Here are 5 bags with 7 taken away. That balances 18.
x was multiplied by 5, then 7 was taken away. So undo the minus 7 first.
Add 7 to both sides. The minus 7 cancels, and the right side grows to 25.
Share 25 between 5 bags. Each bag gets 5.
Check in the original. 5 times 5 minus 7 is 18.
Socks and shoes. Shoes come off first, so undo the last step first.
x over 4, minus 3, equals 2.
Add 3 to both sides first.
Then multiply both sides by 4 to undo the divide.
Now the fraction line covers the whole top. It acts like a bracket.
So multiply both sides by 3 first.
Add 1, then divide by 2. x equals 8.
9 minus 4x equals 21. The x term is minus 4x.
Subtract 9 from both sides. 21 minus 9 is 12.
Divide both sides by minus 4. Keep the sign.
Check. 9 minus 4 times minus 3 is 9 plus 12, which is 21.
A gym charges 40 dollars to join, plus 12 dollars a week. Jai paid 172 dollars.
Write the equation. 40 plus 12w equals 172.

draw.alt: Bar of $172 split into a $40 fee and weekly $12 parts

lines.say: Take away the 40 dollar fee from both sides.
Divide by 12. He paid for 11 weeks.
Let, Equation, Solve, Answer. LESA.
Do the inverse. In 4x plus 9, subtract 9. Don't add it.
Don't divide first. Undo the plus or minus first.
Don't only halve part of a fraction. Multiply both sides by 2.
Minus x equals minus 5 means x equals 5.
Reread the question at the end. Answer what it asks.
Do it to both sides and keep it level.
Change just one side and the scales tip. Then undo the last operation first.
The fraction line is a bracket around the whole top.
Always check your answer in the original equation.
